body:
Addresses #2695 by exposing a public API for HeaderCaseMap
Basically we validate the original spelling bytes by just parsing it as a HeaderName.
Maybe we need to further validate by comparing equivalence? But I'm not sure.

First time contributing to Hyper, let me know if there are issues!

comments.body: Thanks for continuing to explore! I feel like this is a sufficiently interesting enough design space that this would benefit from a design proposal posted to the original issue, first. Would you be interested in collabing on one with me? I've started one in a hackmd, I can send you an invite to edit (I can grab your email from your website) and once it looks good, we can post it for any final feedback. We could collab in the doc itself, or also could start a thread in Discord if you prefer chat (I'm fine with whatever).
Sure thing, we can collab in the hackmd!
@seanmonstar Seems like the hackmd is locked to owner and I can't make any edits.
That's odd. I had set the invite as "write" permissions. But now when I go in, the autocomplete mentions kotx, not just your other email, so maybe it was different accounts. I sent it again to kotx.

Sorry for the wait, I had to deal with finals.

I thought of a better way to perform validation though- `HeaderName`s are guaranteed to be valid header names, and if we use `String` in `HeaderCaseMap`'s spelling representation instead of `Bytes`, we can use `HeaderName`'s `PartialEq<&str>` impl to perform validation.
This has the side effect of requiring spellings to be equivalent to their HeaderNames, but hopefully that falls within expected behavior (i.e. ContentType can't map to "accept").

Alternatively, we can update the `http` crate to include a `PartialEq<Bytes>` or similar?

I'm also concerned that the HeaderCaseMap extension is a bit unwieldy to use, but I'm not sure how to improve it. Maybe there is a more ergonomic public API we could expose, but I'm not sure how well it would fit within the extension model.

Anyways, I updated the proposal doc to reflect these changes. Happy holidays!

title: Add header casing public API
